title: Nourishing Charred Malaysian Chicken Stir-fry
description: A high-protein, one-pot stir-fry that pairs charred chicken with a sweet applesauce glaze and fresh vegetables for a quick, satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Add the chicken cubes and sear for 3-4 minutes, turning until golden brown and almost cooked through.
Push the chicken to one side and add garlic and ginger, sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Return the chicken to the skillet and pour in soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and applesauce, stirring to coat evenly.
Add the sliced bell pepper and broccoli florets, stir-frying for 4-5 minutes until vegetables are crisp-tender.
Reduce heat to medium, cover, and cook for an additional 2 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Remove the lid, stir in a splash of water if needed to loosen sauce, and cook until sauce thickens, about 1 minute.
Taste and adjust seasoning with a pinch of salt or extra soy if desired.
Transfer the stir-fry to a talavera plate, garnish with sliced green onions.
Serve hot over steamed rice or enjoy on its own.
